description: A verdict on the current price of one product: good_price, fair_price, wait or unknown, with a short plain-language reason. It compares today's lowest price with the product's own recent and all-time prices. It returns no price history data. It says whether now is a good time to buy.

id.description: Product id from search results, e.g. "keyboards/keychron-q1-max". A keeb-finder.com product URL also works.

name: get_price_verdict
title: Is this a good price?
